_comment: 1.8.7 Marlow Pike's fish stall on the north beach by the dock. He SELLS fish to the player at steep prices (always well above the barn price, so nothing can be flipped), in limited daily stock that refreshes at local midnight. Quantities are small on purpose. Which fish: any common, uncommon or rare species the player's level can reach (Pier fish once the Pier is rebuilt); legendary and mythic fish are never for sale. Daily choices are seeded by the farm seed and the local day.
name: Marlow Pike
